notes.title: Ragnarok Clicker Announcement 11/21/2019
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

As of today 11/21/2019 at 12:00PM PST, the Ragnarok Clicker server has closed. Thank you again to our amazing community of players for joining us on the Ragnarok Clicker journey! We loved sharing this adventure with you all! 

For more games in the Ragnarok world, please visit us at the warpportal website http://warpportal.com

notes.title: Important Ragnarok Clicker Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25851120/f09d99456c356e7e9f6614ae8789396021729f8e.jpg[/img]

Hello Ragnarok Clicker Heroes!

It is with much excitement that the Ragnarok Clicker team announces an all new Ragnarok Clicker game, RO: Click H5! An all new adventure in the Ragnarok Clicker world, with new exciting features such as live chat and a mail system as well as a unique transmission upgrade system and countless Ragnarok Heroes to collect! The RO: Click H5 server will be opening on Thursday November 7th, 2019!

You can pre-register today on Google Play: [url=]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gravity.roclickerh5.aos[/url]
and the Apple Store:[url=]https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ro-click-h5/id1384253138?l=en&ls=1[/url]
Unfortunately, with the opening of this wonderful new game, we will be closing the original Ragnarok Clicker servers. We want to thank all our Ragnarok Clicker heroes for joining us on the Ragnarok Clicker journey, and we hope you all enjoy RO Click H5, continuing your adventure with even more of Ragnarok Clicker to love! The original Ragnarok Clicker servers will be closing on Thursday, November 21st, 2019.

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding European Region Access
notes.content:
Dear Players,



Due to the changes of our company's service policy for the European regions, we are saddened to bring you news that, all games and WarpPortal services to the European regions listed below will be terminated on May 25th, 2018.



The following European countries will be affected by the termination of service: All the European countries except for Russian Federation and the CIS countries.



All WarpPortal game access and account access will be blocked by regional IP.  Refunds will be gradually sent for purchases made from February 1st 2018 to April 30th 2018 to those affected by this service termination.



We have updated our User Agreement and Privacy Policy to reflect the new changes going forward.



We thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Finally an Update! aka new look but same game
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25851120/a54cffa3e6442d796eafd42e3af7fc87ffd835c6.png[/img]

I personally apologize for the lack of updates from the development of the game in general. We hit some bumps in the road while re-designing the UI but this was a necessary step before we could proceed with any future plans.
That being said here is what was done and what we plan on doing

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Guild Limit Increased to 20 members[/b]
[*]GUI updated some UI buttons were moved so be sure you know where you're clicking.
[*]Monster images changed to vector images to scale better and run smoother
***The Ancient Mimic treasure box and Thors Volcano background still needs a makeover***

[/list]

[b]Future Plans[/b]
[list]
[*]Addition of new monster cards and stat abilities

[*]Guild monsters increased in difficulty
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and your continued support for the game.

notes.title: Poring over some new things to come!
notes.content:
It has been one crazy week since we officially launched the game! I want to thank the community for its patience as we iron out the kinks and for making the game so popular.  As a small token of appreciation, I would like to share some of the development plans coming down the pipeline. Many of you have voiced concerns that this game is exactly the same as [b]Clicker Heroes[/b]. It is no secret that this game’s base is the original game developed by [i]Playsaurus[/i]. But have no fear! We are working together to make this game a unique gaming experience incorporating the fantastical world of Ragnarok. 

One of the main features that we are looking at expanding is the guilds. It was something we were looking into and your voices confirmed it! Expanding group activities outside of the daily raids and creating more guild member space is one of the priorities that we are putting for the game.

Another priority is to update the game’s “classic” look to a more modern one by adding newly drawn monsters and GUI assets. Here’s an idea of what we all have to look forward to. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25851120/cded4d031dd0dd67a91320dd63b423a80c17547c.jpg[/img]
NOTE: This is a concept image done by an artist and we know that some of the wording and names are incorrect ːsteamhappyː

Now all of these are in development which means that they do take some time to implement. In the meantime, we will be working on rolling out client patches/updates to fix any bugs and tweak features to better match the Ragnarok world. The background music per level was a result of community response so your feedback is greatly appreciated and considered so we look forward to hearing from you all. 
[b]Thanks for all the clicks![/b]
